steps.note: Open the prepared closed RFQ summary containing the bid.
Enable eRFX projects as required by the case.
Apply the required post-expiry surrogate-bid configuration.
Apply the required buyer bid-edit configuration.
Open Recreate Order from the RFQ stage Settings menu.
Verify that the Recreate Order window opened.
Set the recreated order's event end-time duration to 60 minutes.
Choose the requested future delivery date.
Create the order with the completed valid fields.
Verify that the Recreate Order window closed after creation.
Verify the new order entry shows the 60-minute event end time.
Verify the new order entry shows the 45-minute evaluation duration.
Verify the new order entry shows the selected delivery date.
Verify the creation success confirmation when the toast is shown.
